units.name: Bone Captain

copyPolicy.reason: Level II threat names Bone Captain; locked source contains a narrow artwork component (46111) and full Large combat card (46600). These are distinct components, not two spawn copies. Official association/copy instruction is not explicit.

sourceReferences.literal:
[LEVEL:II]
[GREEN_DUNGEON_ARCH]
Army of the Dead
At the start of the first Battle in this Dungeon, spawn a Bone Captain as the first Monster.
[LOWER_HALF_ROTATED_180]
Haunted Graveyard
On the first preparation day, Heroes roll a [D10]. The Hero with the lowest roll is forced to spend the first day visiting the Graveyard for guard duty. They can use the Graveyard's effect as normal.

sourceReferences.region: Large Monsters have cards spanning two slots

units.scope: Narrow artwork and full Large combat card are kept distinct

alias.reason: Bone Rabble printed on Boss I and monster cards; Bone Rubble on core p38. No acquired superseding erratum establishes equivalence or precedence.

rosterPolicy: Only Rabble / Soldier / Spearman named on Battle Skills; Captain is a pre-Boss Dungeon Threat spawn. Courtier and Defender exist but are not eligible by those Skills.
